name: tank-driver
note: A human gunner's tank cannon launches a shell. Dustbowl with -SpawnIndex 3,5 puts the driver 17.6 m from tank 2 at yaw ~315. Walk there, take the seat before the bots are released (30 s after the first player body), then fire. Grade: the server's authoritative Rocket/Shell explosion line appears after 'firing', and UnlaunchedMountedShots stays 0. Before the 2026-09-23 fix the authority booked the shot and launched nothing.
